text:
Lina M: quick one — dashboard shows p95 for /complete jumped in the endpoint view but per-variant charts look normal. anyone seen metric semantics change?
Victor H: I noticed that too when I was comparing model-variants. The endpoint rollup seems to be merging metric_name=compute_ms with metric_name=service_ms.
Zoe P: oh no. compute_ms is compute-only, service_ms includes queue time. merging those will inflate percentiles if some requests got queued.
Lina M: exactly. the endpoint view aggregates by endpoint only and drops metric_name tag. that makes p50 stable but p95 jump because a small subset with queue heavy samples got mixed in.
Victor H: quick repro: ConsoleBot, can we query counts by metric_name for that endpoint over the 5min window?
ConsoleBot: query started: SELECT count() BY metric_name FROM latency_vectors WHERE endpoint='/complete' AND ts BETWEEN 1779996000 AND 1779996300
metrics-bot: results: metric_name=compute_ms count=4320; metric_name=service_ms count=42
Zoe P: there you go. 42 service_ms samples (mostly requeues) pollute the merged percentile.
Lina M: action: UI should never drop metric_name when merging percentiles across variants. short-term hack: mark endpoint-level percentiles with a provenance badge "mixed metrics" and gray p95 if contributors < 50 samples.
Victor H: long-term: change rollup API to require exact-match semantics for metric_name and route_variant unless explicitly requested. also add a validation that warns when tags are dropped.
Zoe P: I'll open a tiny console PR to show a "metric provenance" pill and hide blended pctl when small contributors dominate.
Lina M: and infra please emit a telemetry warning when metric_name cardinality changes for an endpoint (Victor?).
Victor H: will file IR ticket and add a small pipeline check.
Lina M: thanks. learning: endpoints can look healthy at median but tails get messed up if we don't respect metric semantics. cc: oncall if we need to revert any recent tag-dropping optimizations.
ConsoleBot: UI patch deployed to staging behind flag tenant.metric_provenance
metrics-bot: ticket created IR-4210: "enforce-metric-semantics-in-rollups" assigned to @Victor H
Lina M: perfect. follow up after PR lands and we'll re-evaluate p95 trends.
